home_faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
home_faq.subtitle: Transparent insights regarding safety standards, local host vetting, and payment escrow guarantees.

items.q: How does Locallytrip verify local guides (Hosts)?
items.a: Every local host is required to undergo strict AI-assisted government ID verification (KYC), an authenticity interview assessing local expertise, and safety background screening before listing any activity. Our vetting guidelines comply with the sustainable tourism standards set by the Indonesian Ministry of Tourism (Kemenparekraf RI).

items.q: How does the payment security and escrow system work?
items.a: Locallytrip utilizes a secure payment escrow system. Your booking funds are held safely and only disbursed to the local host after the experience is successfully concluded according to description.

items.q: What are LTP Reward Points and how do I redeem them?
items.a: LTP (Locallytrip Points) are loyalty rewards earned on every completed booking and community contribution. You can redeem these points directly at checkout for up to 50% discount on future adventures.

items.q: Can I book private tours or request a customized itinerary?
items.a: Absolutely! You can utilize the Direct Chat feature before booking to communicate directly with any host, customizing your route, start time, or special family requests.

explore_faq.title: Destination & Local Guide Selection Guide
explore_faq.subtitle: Essential insights to help plan your authentic and safe journey across Indonesia.

items.q: How do I choose the best destination and authentic local activities?
items.a: You can utilize our search filters by exploring top popular cities or browsing curated travel vibes (Hidden Nature, Artisan Culture, Coastal Waves, Midnight Street Food). Each city destination showcases the volume of active experiences and community meetups.

items.q: Are local guides verified with official identity checks?
items.a: Yes, all featured local guides (Hosts) on Locallytrip must pass government ID verification (KYC) and profile background reviews. Our guide verification adheres to sustainable tourism standards to ensure your journey is insightful, authentic, and safe.

items.q: How does Locallytrip ensure booking security and buyer protection?
items.a: Every transaction is protected by our secure escrow system. Your payment is held safely and only disbursed to the local guide after your booked tour or meetup is fulfilled as scheduled. You can also message hosts directly beforehand.

help_page.metaTitle: Help Center & FAQ - Locallytrip | Traveler & Host Guides
help_page.metaDescription: Get quick answers on how to book experiences, escrow payment security, host requirements, cancellation policies, and LTP reward points.
help_page.heroTitle: How Can We Help You Today?
help_page.heroSubtitle: Clear answers and comprehensive guidance covering bookings, host onboarding, payment escrow, and community security.
help_page.searchPlaceholder: Search questions or keywords (e.g., refund, host, escrow)...
help_page.q1: How do I book a local tour experience?
help_page.a1: Browse destinations and select an experience from verified hosts. Pick your preferred date and group size, then click "Book Now". Once payment is verified, you can coordinate directly with your host via private messaging to confirm meeting details.
help_page.a2: 100% secure. All booking transactions are safeguarded by PT Locallytrip Teknologi Indonesia's official escrow system. Your funds are protected and only released to the host after the tour has been successfully completed.
help_page.q3: What happens if my plans change or I need to cancel?
help_page.a3: Locallytrip offers a 100% full refund guarantee when cancellation is submitted at least 48 hours prior to the scheduled tour start time. Cancellations can be initiated easily from your account dashboard.
help_page.q4: What are the requirements to become a Host?
help_page.a4: You must hold a valid government-issued ID (Passport/National ID) for KYC verification, possess deep insider knowledge of your locality, and commit to providing warm, respectful, and safe hospitality.
help_page.q5: How much does it cost to list an experience as a Host?
help_page.a5: Registration and listing your tours on Locallytrip is completely free with zero monthly subscription fees. We only charge a transparent 10%–15% platform service fee upon successfully completed bookings.
help_page.q6: What is the purpose of LTP coins and XP Levels?
help_page.a6: XP (Experience Points) represents your reputation score and unlocks verified community badges. LTP coins are earned loyalty rewards that can be redeemed as direct discount vouchers on upcoming tour bookings.
help_page.q7: What if there is an issue or emergency during the tour?
help_page.a7: The Locallytrip support team is on standby daily (Monday–Sunday, 08:00–21:00 WIB) via support@locallytrip.com and our emergency assistance trigger within your activity dashboard.
help_page.stillNeedHelpDesc: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out directly and our customer care team will assist you.

privacy_page.metaTitle: Privacy Policy - Locallytrip | Personal Data Protection
privacy_page.metaDescription: Learn how PT Locallytrip Teknologi Indonesia safeguards personal information, encrypted KYC data, and guarantees zero third-party data selling.
privacy_page.section1Text: PT Locallytrip Teknologi Indonesia ("Locallytrip", "we", "us") is dedicated to protecting the confidentiality and security of personal information belonging to both Travelers and Local Hosts. This policy clearly explains how we process your information ethically and in accordance with applicable laws.
privacy_page.section2Text: We collect only essential data necessary for seamless marketplace operations:
privacy_page.collectItem1: Basic Contact Information: Full name, verified email address, and mobile phone number (for tour coordination and on-trip logistics via WhatsApp/phone).
privacy_page.collectItem2: Identity Verification (KYC): Government-issued ID (KTP/Passport) uploaded exclusively by Host applicants. This documentation is securely encrypted and accessed only by our compliance team.
privacy_page.collectItem3: Usage & Bookings: Completed tour reservations, feedback reviews, and activity preferences to personalize destination recommendations.
privacy_page.section3Text: Collected information is strictly used to: (a) Facilitate authentic and authorized booking transactions; (b) Verify host identity and maintain guest safety standards; (c) Provide dedicated customer support; and (d) Protect all users from fraudulent account activity or payment chargebacks.
privacy_page.section4Text: Locallytrip adheres to an uncompromised ethical privacy standard: your personal information is never rented, licensed, or sold to third-party data brokers or marketing advertisers for commercial gain.
privacy_page.section5Text: You maintain absolute rights over your information: you may view, update, download an export of your personal data, or request permanent account deletion at any time by emailing support@locallytrip.com.
privacy_page.companyEntity: Legally operated by PT Locallytrip Teknologi Indonesia

terms_page.metaTitle: Terms & Conditions - Locallytrip | Marketplace Service Terms
terms_page.metaDescription: Official Terms of Service for Locallytrip marketplace, escrow payment rules, community standards, cancellation terms, and force majeure protection.
terms_page.section1Text: Locallytrip is owned and operated by PT Locallytrip Teknologi Indonesia as a technology marketplace connecting independent travelers with self-employed local guides (Hosts). Hosts act as independent contractors and are not direct employees or agents of Locallytrip.
terms_page.section2Text: The Locallytrip community is grounded in mutual respect and safety. Any form of harassment, hate speech, racial or religious discrimination, sexual misconduct, or hazardous behavior during tours is strictly prohibited. Violators face immediate permanent suspension and may be reported to law enforcement authorities.
terms_page.section3Text: All bookings must be processed through Locallytrip's authorized platform payment infrastructure. Guest payments are held securely in escrow by PT Locallytrip Teknologi Indonesia and are only released to the host's wallet after the tour experience has been successfully completed without unresolved safety disputes.
terms_page.section4Text: Travelers are entitled to a 100% full refund when cancellation is submitted at least 48 hours prior to the scheduled tour start time. Cancellations made within less than 48 hours may be subject to host preparation compensation fees as specified in the individual package terms.
terms_page.section5Text: If a tour cannot proceed due to events beyond reasonable human control—including natural disasters, hazardous weather conditions, civil unrest, or official government closures of tourist sites—both parties are relieved of fulfillment obligations, and travelers are entitled to a full refund or free rescheduling.
